constraints: LEI Data Terms of Use (verified 2026-09-22): 'The data available through the Access Service are provided under the CC0 licence, see CC0 1.0 Universal (CC0 1.0)'; the terms forbid presenting data as GLEIF-provided or -authorized and any false association with GLEIF or the LEI system
the page https://www.gleif.org/en/about/gleif-services/terms-of-use named in the plan returns 404; the terms are at /en/meta/lei-data-terms-of-use

the ISO 20275 Entity Legal Forms code list page states no license of its own and the LEI Data Terms of Use do not name it; treated as an open item for 0.4. Current file: https://www.gleif.org/lei-data/code-lists/iso-20275-entity-legal-forms-code-list/2026-02-19-elf-code-list-v1.6.csv

API (probed 2026-09-22): page[size] must be between 1 and 200 (HTTP 400 above 200); no rate-limit headers are returned and the documentation page is rendered by script and could not be read, so sampling keeps to at most one request per second
GE has 162 active records (probe on 2026-09-22), so the Georgian org sample will be small and must be supplemented from Wikidata
format: Level 1 golden copy CSV (LEI-CDF 3.1), streamed from its zip; columns used: LEI, Entity.LegalName, Entity.LegalName.xmllang, Entity.LegalJurisdiction, Entity.LegalForm.EntityLegalFormCode, Entity.EntityStatus, Entity.EntityCategory

filters.rules: names NFC with whitespace collapsed; dropped: shorter than 3 bytes, the word LEI, duplicates by (country, lowercase name)

split_rule: fnv1a64(0, lowercase normalized name) % 100: 0-89 train, 90-94 valid, 95-99 test; names are NFC with whitespace runs collapsed to one space
